what_changed: FCC CGB plans to dismiss 24 mooted or outdated petitions filed 2003-2023 in TCPA and robocall dockets (CG 02-278, 05-338, 17-59) unless a party objects by October 15, 2026.
rationale: Dismissing petitions leaves the TCPA rules unchanged. Near the line because the abstract does not list the petitions, some of which may concern servicing or collection calls. Stage A: title, abstract, metadata and eCFR diff excerpt only; full text not read.
